bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
cd "$HOME/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot"
stage="deploy/state/help-compact-final-20261123"
old_sha="db730471a961f54700fde3e1761d3b7f9dbcaf206291f202936240f5bc5c54aa"
new_sha="f5c3b09b915031b94c1b2c9ab86b5c4af74a52bc73256dfc758920d714fb3106"
old_image="$(docker image inspect -f '{{.Id}}' gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:before-help-profile-20261123)"
new_image="$(docker image inspect -f '{{.Id}}' gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:help-profile-20261123)"
test -s "$stage/build-checkpoint.json"
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.Image}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)" = "$old_image"
test "$(docker image inspect -f '{{.Id}}' gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:local)" = "$old_image"
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)" = true
test "$(docker exec deploy-gaybbs-1 sha256sum /app/gaybbs.mjs | cut -d' ' -f1)" = "$old_sha"
test "$(sha256sum "$stage/gaybbs-target-only.mjs" | cut -d' ' -f1)" = "$new_sha"
test "$new_image" != "$old_image"
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' deploy-postgres-1)" = true
test ! -e deploy/state/help-profile-deploy-20261123.json
docker image tag gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:help-profile-20261123 gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:local
if ! docker compose -f deploy/gserver-compose.yaml up -d --no-deps --no-build --force-recreate gaybbs >/dev/null;then
 docker image tag gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:before-help-profile-20261123 gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:local
 docker compose -f deploy/gserver-compose.yaml up -d --no-deps --no-build --force-recreate gaybbs >/dev/null || true
 exit 70
fi
sleep 5
if test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.Image}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)" != "$new_image" || test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)" != true || test "$(docker exec deploy-gaybbs-1 sha256sum /app/gaybbs.mjs | cut -d' ' -f1)" != "$new_sha";then
 docker image tag gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:before-help-profile-20261123 gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:local
 docker compose -f deploy/gserver-compose.yaml up -d --no-deps --no-build --force-recreate gaybbs >/dev/null || true
 exit 71
fi
test "$(docker exec deploy-gaybbs-1 stat -c '%u:%g:%a' /app/gaybbs.mjs)" = "1000:1000:600"
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Restarting}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)" = false
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' deploy-postgres-1)" = true
docker exec deploy-gaybbs-1 node -e 'const s=require("fs").readFileSync("/app/gaybbs.mjs","utf8");const a=s.indexOf("function registerOperationHelpHandlers("),b=s.indexOf("// src/",a+8);const x=s.slice(a,b<0?s.length:b);if(!s.includes("STARTLESS_REPEATED_START_LINK_FORBIDDEN")||!x.includes("startCompactProfileEditor(ctx)")||x.includes("startProfileEditor(ctx)"))process.exit(77);'
printf '{"state":"VERIFIED","old_image":"%s","new_image":"%s","old_sha":"%s","new_sha":"%s","scope":"operationHelpHandlers and gaybbsBot only","source_pr":72}\n' "$old_image" "$new_image" "$old_sha" "$new_sha" > deploy/state/help-profile-deploy-20261123.json
echo "HELP_COMPACT_PROFILE_LIVE_DEPLOY_AND_RUNTIME_GUARDS=PASS"
